sentences.text:
This is an Application under section 438 of Cr.P.C. filed by the aforesaid Applicant
apprehending his arrest in C.R.No.242/2020 registered with Oshiwara Police
Station, Mumbai for offences punishable under sections 179, 188, 273, 328, 120(B) of
the Indian Penal Code, sections 26(ii), 4, 27(iii) of Food Safety and Standard Act,
2006 along with Disaster Management Act, 2005, section 51(b) of The Epidemic
Diseases Act, 1897 and sections 37(3) and 135 of Maharashtra Police Act.
2. Heard learned counsel for the Applicant and learned APP for the State.
I have perused the records and considered the submissions advanced by the learned counsel for the respective parties.

By detailed order dated 12/05/2020 passed by this Court (Coram : Smt. Sadhana S. Jadhav, J.)
had granted interim protection to the Applicant.
It is stated that pursuant to the said order, the Applicant has reported to the Investigating Officer and that he has been interrogated.
